events.title: SoLuna: Sacred Sound Journey at Imagine Gathering 2026
events.location: Doe Bay Resort & Retreat, Orcas Island, WA
description: Join Valera and Amaris for an immersive sound meditation inspired by the natural beauty of Orcas Island. A woven soundscape of four large gongs tuned to 432 Hz, sacred instruments, and gentle guided meditation invites deep rest, reflection, and inner discovery.
Journey through guided imagery inspired by orcas and the Salish Sea as sound, water, and breath come together to release tension, calm the nervous system, and restore clarity and balance.
